body:
954% ROI. One number, one pilot, one enterprise client.

OpenAI's new report, "Credit Saison achieves 954% ROI in a ChatGPT Enterprise pilot," is already being posted everywhere today.

Here's the distinction nobody in the replies is making. ROI, return on investment, means money made back compared to money spent. A pilot means a small, controlled test, not a company-wide rollout. One finance company's internal pilot number is not a benchmark for your business, your team, or your ad account.

What ChatGPT Enterprise is actually good at, based on what OpenAI describes: automating repetitive internal work like document review, support replies, and research summaries, at a scale with proper data controls.

What it is not: a growth or ads tool. It won't lower your cost per lead, won't write a form that converts better, won't fix a leaky follow-up process. Nothing in this report touches media buying at all.

If you're a freelancer or a small business owner reading the headline and wondering if you need this: ask what repetitive task eats your week first. Not what tool everyone else is posting about.

What's the one task in your business that you redo every single day without thinking?
